pr_title: fix: ensure unowned derived dependencies are not duplicated when reac…
pr_body: Fixes https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/issues/15229. When we reconnect a derived that was previously unowned and tacking skipped, we only add a single reaction – however, the original derived might have had multiple dependencies. Duplicate dependencies is fine for owned deriveds, however for unowned we should be a little more resilient to ensure we're not falling into the fail case.

issue_context.title: Reactivity regression with `5.19.5` with conditional function calls
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

I had a [bug report](https://github.com/techniq/layerchart/issues/376) in LayerChart that took me a while to track down.  It appears between `5.19.4` and `5.19.5` there was a change with reactivity for conditional function calls.

When `labelAccessor(data)` returns `undefined`, it will fallback to `keyAccessor(data)` but if `data` changes the result is not updated (but `valueAccessor(data)` and others are).

```svelte
<slot name="tooltip" {...slotProps}>
  <Tooltip.Root {...props.tooltip?.root} let:data>
    <Tooltip.List {...props.tooltip?.list}>
      <Tooltip.Item
        label={labelAccessor(data) || keyAccessor(data)}
        value={valueAccessor(data)}
        color={cScale?.(c(data))}
        {format}
        {...props.tooltip?.item}
      />
    </Tooltip.List>
  </Tooltip.Root>
</slot>
```

One workaround is to pull the values up into separate `{@const}`

```svelte
<slot name="tooltip" {...slotProps}>
  <Tooltip.Root {...props.tooltip?.root} let:data>
   {@const label = labelAccessor(data)}
   {@const key = keyAccessor(data)}
    <Tooltip.List {...props.tooltip?.list}>
      <Tooltip.Item
        label={label || key}
        value={valueAccessor(data)}
        color={cScale?.(c(data))}
        {format}
        {...props.tooltip?.item}
      />
    </Tooltip.List>
  </Tooltip.Root>
</slot>
```

But even more surprising is pulling up just the `key` value (but still use the same fallback) triggers the update.
```svelte
<slot name="tooltip" {...slotProps}>
  <Tooltip.Root {...props.tooltip?.root} let:data>
   {@const key = keyAccessor(data)}
    <Tooltip.List {...props.tooltip?.list}>
      <Tooltip.Item
        label={labelAccessor(data) || keyAccessor(data)}
        value={valueAccessor(data)}
        color={cScale?.(c(data))}
        {format}
        {...props.tooltip?.item}
      />
    </Tooltip.List>
  </Tooltip.Root>
</slot>
```

The later is the [workaround](https://github.com/techniq/layerchart/commit/1722d202045e7555536dc2fd1113c4dc7dfb9587) I added to LayerChart in `0.93.8`

### Reproduction

Running `svelte: '^5.9.5'` with `layerchart: '0.93.7'` and moving between PieChart arcs shows the issue (without the Tooltip unmounting).

See this [repo](https://github.com/anatoliy-t7/layerchart-pie-chart-bug) created for the LayerChart issue (thanks @anatoliy-t7).  See also the video in the original [issue](https://github.com/techniq/layerchart/issues/376) for a demonstration.
